Consecutively missing multiple times within 2.5 seconds of each grants 25? Stability for 2.5 seconds.

Buff is removed 1? second after scoring a Hit. Missing again refreshes the buff duration.

Misses in a row required:
• Auto Rifles, Submachine Guns: 10
• Pulse Rifles: 9
• Hand Cannons: 4
• Linear Fusion Rifles: 2
